answers.core:
Checking if an area is currently colliding or getting all current collisions is a behavior used commonly enough that it should be built in to the area node.

(I know bodies entering/exiting areas are technically not collisions, so the language would need to be updated to be more accurate)
answers.workaround: It would all be possible through a script, but it will be used often enough that making this behavior built in would be worth it.

title: Add a way for areas to report current collisions or whether they are colliding
